bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; providing restitution for public agencies and victims affected by the reporting of a fictitious emergency; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.78, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.78, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 2d.

Restitution.

(a) The court, while imposing a sentence on a person convicted under subdivision 2, clause (2), shall order the person to make full and complete restitution to:

(1) the public agency for the reasonable costs of the emergency response by that public agency; and

(2) a direct victim of the fictitious emergency.

(b) A restitution payment under paragraph (a) does not limit the liability for damages in a civil action or proceeding for an amount greater than the restitution payment.
